sources.prompt: One seamless square game terrain material for Soulmonsters, directly overhead texture, not landscape. Clean flat 2D colored manga / cel-animation cut-paper visual style. Pale warm sand in FOUR FLAT SOLID COLORS: #DDBD7D main fill, #EACF97 broad quiet irregular planes, #C4A366 sparse winding wind ripple strokes, #927449 very few short selective ink accents. Only 8 groups of 2 or 3 interrupted gently curving wind ripples in the entire square, each group different size and direction, large clean quiet areas between groups. NO dunes or hills painted into texture, NO drop shadows, NO stones, NO shells, NO plants, NO footprints, NO speckles, NO grain, NO watercolor, NO gradients, NO photorealism. Smooth sharp boundaries and sparse hand ink lines. This material will be mapped onto actual gently raised dunes in game. No borders, labels, icons, regular pattern, or frame. Seamlessly repeatable opposite edges.

One isolated low sandstone outcrop game prop, orthographic isometric 2:1 view, Soulmonsters living-paper 2D colored manga cel-animation style. A single compact cluster of 3 broad wind eroded sandstone slabs, layered folded-paper-like planes with rounded worn corners, low wide asymmetric silhouette, visible base firmly resting on the floor. Pale ochre top #D6B278, warm tan mid #B98E56, terracotta shadow #8B6246, crisp selective dark brown navy outline #3C3540. Large clean flat planes, 4-5 colors only, no gradient, no grain, no speckled stone, no photoreal texture, no watercolor, no 3D render, no dramatic tall pillars, no glowing crystals, no symbols or faces. One small natural diamond-shaped split between two slabs evokes folded kite structure subtly. No sand patch, no plants, no shadows outside the object, no scenery, no text, no border. Entire outcrop visible, true transparent background.
